title: Ruaha National Park: Wild, Big and Quiet
excerpt: Ruaha is one of Tanzania's largest parks: wild, rugged and remote, with big lion prides, elephants and very few other visitors.
body:
Ruaha National Park lies in central southern Tanzania and is among the largest parks in East Africa. It is a park for people who want wilderness.

## Landscapes

Rocky hills, baobabs, dry riverbeds and the Great Ruaha River. The park sits in a transition zone between East and Southern African ecosystems, so you see species from both.

## Wildlife

- Large lion prides.
- Leopards and cheetahs.
- Big elephant herds.
- Greater and lesser kudu, sable and roan antelope.
- African wild dogs.
- Hundreds of bird species.

## Activities

Game drives, walking safaris and in some camps fly camping.

## Best time

Dry season, roughly June to October, when animals gather at the river. The green season is beautiful but some camps close.

## Getting there

By light aircraft from Dar es Salaam, Arusha or Zanzibar, or by road via [Iringa](/blog/iringa-guide/).

Read our [Ruaha page](/national-parks/ruaha-national-park/) or [plan your trip](/travel-proposal/).
